{{Quote|Hmmm? You must be a new recruit. This crew changes faces faster than a Shi'odo spy... But I'm glad we have some fresh blood: The last "pirate" who wandered in here is still being digested by a kimogila somewhere past Rancid Ridge.|[[Jinkins]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:J">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=conversation|Jinkins|Lok}}</ref>}}
'''Rancid Ridge''' was a location on the desert [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lok/Legends|Lok]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] of the [[Lok Revenants/Legends|Lok Revenants]] was eaten by a [[kimogila]] near Rancid Ridge.<ref name="SWG:J" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rancid Ridge was mentioned in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:J" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Rancid Ridge was mentioned by [[Jinkins]] during "[[W:c:swg:Nym's Theme Park|Nym's Theme Park]],"<ref name="SWG:J" /> a questline introduced with the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 3 Notes: 8 October 03|Publish 3]]" on [[October 8]], 2003.<ref name="SonyCite-Publish 3: The Warren">{{SonyCite|url=recent_updates.jsp?o=60890|text=Publish 3: The Warren}}</ref> With the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 16|Game Update 16]]," on [[March 23]], [[2010]],<ref name="SonyCite-Game Update 16: ''Star Wars'' Galaxies™: Stronghold of the Lok Revenants">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=68713&month=032010|text=Game Update 16: ''Star Wars'' Galaxies™: Stronghold of the Lok Revenants}}</ref> Nym's Theme Park was revamped and Rancid Ridge was removed from Jinkins' dialogues.<ref name="SWG:FJ">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Find Jinkins|Lok}}</ref>
